kurzbeschreibung: Innsbruck – the Alpine metropolis with the world-famous Golden Roof, surrounded by mighty peaks and situated directly on the Inn River.
beschreibung: Innsbruck, the state capital of Tyrol, uniquely combines big-city flair with an alpine lifestyle. The historic old town with the Golden Roof, the Hofburg Palace, and the Court Church tell the story of 800 years of Habsburg history. At the same time, the Nordkettenbahn funicular takes you from the city center to 2,256 m altitude in just 20 minutes – straight into the Karwendel mountain world. The Patscherkofel and Axamer Lizum were venues for the 1964 and 1976 Winter Olympics. Innsbruck is also an important educational center with the University of Innsbruck and the Leopold-Franzens University.
tipps: The Innsbruck Card is worth it for 24/48/72h: Free rides on cable cars, museums & public transport.
The Alpine Zoo in Hungerburg is the highest zoo in Europe – an experience for the whole family.
Best view: from the Hafelekar summit station (2,334 m) of the Nordkettenbahn.
empfehlungen: Start at the Golden Roof in the old town, stroll along Maria-Theresien-Straße to St. Anne's Column, then take the Nordkettenbahn up to the Karwendel. The restaurant Stiftskeller serves traditional Tyrolean cuisine under historic vaulted ceilings.
umgebung: Innsbruck lies in the Inn Valley between the Nordketten (Karwendel) in the north and the Tux Alps in the south. The region includes the municipalities of Hall in Tirol, Wattens, and the Stubaital to the south. Neighboring regions: Stubaital (10 km), Mittelgebirge (Telfes, Lans).
